```{r load-data}
dataset <- readxl::read_excel("Credit_Risk_Dataset_Onyx_Data_September_25.xlsx")

# Calculate proportions of categorical variables
library(dplyr)

data <- dataset |>
  select(person_home_ownership, loan_intent) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), as.factor))

prop_home_ownership <- prop.table(table(data$person_home_ownership))
prop_loan_intent <- prop.table(table(data$loan_intent))

print(prop_home_ownership)
print(prop_loan_intent)


```

```{r create-model}

encoded_dataset <- read.csv("encoded_dataset.csv")

library(tidyverse)
library(xgboost)

# Prepare data
x_train <- encoded_dataset |>
  filter(is_train == 1) |>
  select(-is_train, -client_ID)
x_test <- encoded_dataset |>
  filter(is_train == 0) |>
  select(-is_train, -client_ID)

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = as.matrix(select(x_train, -loan_status)),
  label = x_train$loan_status
)

dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = as.matrix(select(x_test, -loan_status)),
  label = x_test$loan_status
)

# Train
params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "auc"
)

xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = params, data = dtrain, nrounds = 200,
  watchlist = list(train = dtrain, test = dtest),
  verbose = 0
)

```


```{r generate-synthetic}

# Parameters
N_synth <- 50000


# Sampling function
sample_by_purpose <- function(dataset, N, prop_weights) {
  purposes <- names(prop_weights)
  counts <- round(N * prop_weights |> unname() / sum(prop_weights))
  sampled <- map2_dfr(purposes, counts, function(p, cnt) {
    base <- dataset |> filter(loan_intent == p)
    if (nrow(base) == 0) {
      return(tibble())
    }
    base |> sample_n(size = cnt, replace = TRUE)
  })
  sampled
}

# Generate synthetic borrowers
synth <- sample_by_purpose(dataset, N_synth, prop_loan_intent)

# Add jitter to numeric features
numeric_cols <- c(
  "person_age", "person_income",
  "person_emp_length", "loan_amnt", "loan_to_income_ratio"
)
factor_cols <- c("loan_intent", "person_home_ownership")

synth <- synth |>
  mutate(across(all_of(numeric_cols), ~ .x * exp(rnorm(n(), 0, 0.05))))

# Assign home ownership randomly according to weights
synth$person_home_ownership <- sample(names(prop_home_ownership),
  nrow(synth),
  replace = TRUE, prob = prop_home_ownership
)

# Separate categorical and numeric features

train <- synth |> select(all_of(c(numeric_cols, factor_cols)))
train <- train |> mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))

# Encode factors
encoded_loan_intent <- model.matrix(~ loan_intent - 1, data = train) |> as.data.frame()
encoded_home_ownership <- model.matrix(~ person_home_ownership - 1, data = train) |> as.data.frame()

train <- cbind(train, encoded_loan_intent, encoded_home_ownership)
train <- train |> select(-all_of(factor_cols))

dmat <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = as.matrix(train)
)

# Predict PD
synth$Predicted_PD <- predict(xgb_model, dmat)

# Add bins for slicers
synth <- synth |>
  mutate(
    age_bin = cut(person_age,
      breaks = c(20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 100),
      labels = c("20-24", "25-29", "30-34", "35-39", "40-44", "45+"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    income_bin = cut(person_income,
      breaks = c(0, 25000, 50000, 75000, 100000, 1e6),
      labels = c("0-25k", "25-50k", "50-75k", "75-100k", "100k+"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    loan_amount_bin = cut(loan_amnt,
      breaks = c(0, 5000, 10000, 20000, 40000, 1e6),
      labels = c("0-5k", "5-10k", "10-20k", "20-40k", "40k+"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    lti_bin = cut(loan_to_income_ratio,
      breaks = c(0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 1),
      labels = c("0-0.1", "0.1-0.2", "0.2-0.3", "0.3+"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  )

# Output for Power BI
output <- synth |>
  mutate(Borrower_ID = row_number()) |>
  select(
    Borrower_ID, loan_intent, person_home_ownership,
    age_bin, income_bin, loan_amount_bin, lti_bin,
    person_age, person_income, person_emp_length,
    loan_amnt, loan_to_income_ratio,
    Predicted_PD
  )

output |> glimpse()

```
